titleEn: You’ve been told to prep three days of food, but moving past day four will need stronger supply chains
titleZh: 备好三天食物之后呢？更长久的应急保障需要强大供应链
method: Machine reference translation with paragraph alignment; not manually certified.

paragraphs.en: The UK government’s recent “Be Ready” campaign advises households to keep a three-day supply of food and drink in case of emergency. Sales of bottled water and tinned foods have soared, as households ready themselves for a powerful storm, a long power cut or a cyber-attack.
paragraphs.zh: 英国政府最近发起的“做好准备”（Be Ready）运动建议，家庭应保持三天的食物和饮料供应，以备不时之需。随着家庭为应对强风暴、长时间停电或网络攻击做好准备，瓶装水和罐装食品的销量飙升。

paragraphs.en: And preparing for three days of self-resilience seems like a sensible measure. But what happens on day four?
paragraphs.zh: 准备三天的自我恢复似乎是一个明智的措施，但第四天会发生什么呢？

paragraphs.en: The hope would be that order is restored, with no further need for people to rely on their own supplies.
paragraphs.zh: 希望是秩序得以恢复，人们不再需要依赖自己的供应。

paragraphs.en: But what if the supply chains we rely on every day have not recovered in time? After all, it’s not as if they’re not vulnerable to attack.
paragraphs.zh: 但是，如果我们每天依赖的供应链没有及时恢复怎么办？毕竟，它们也不是不容易受到攻击。

paragraphs.en: Part of this vulnerability is down to companies using what we call a “just-in-time” strategy, where goods are produced or delivered just at the point that they are needed.
paragraphs.zh: 造成这种脆弱性的部分原因是企业采用了我们所说的“准时制”战略，即在需要的时候生产或交付货物。

paragraphs.en: This means companies holding minimal stock levels, which reduces costs and waste. It can also involve using the same software across the supply chain to improve visibility and ensure accurate forecasting of demand.
paragraphs.zh: 这意味着企业保持最低库存水平，从而降低成本和浪费。它还可以涉及在整个供应链中使用相同的软件，以提高可见性并确保准确预测需求。

paragraphs.en: And while all of these measures dramatically improve efficiency, one failure can hit several supply chains at once.
paragraphs.zh: 虽然所有这些措施都能显著提高效率，但一个故障可能会同时影响多个供应链。

paragraphs.en: For example, in 2024, a cyber-attack on a supply-chain software company disrupted warehouse management systems and the supply of fresh produce for UK supermarkets. In 2025, a refrigerated logistics firm was targeted, causing widespread delays and cancellations of deliveries.
paragraphs.zh: 例如，2024年，一家供应链软件公司遭到网络攻击，导致英国超市的仓库管理系统和生鲜农产品供应中断; 2025年，一家冷藏物流公司成为攻击目标，导致配送大范围延迟和取消。

paragraphs.en: Also in 2025, a cyber-attack on M&S led to a five-day suspension of online sales and empty shelves in stores.
paragraphs.zh: 同样是在2025年，玛莎百货遭遇网络攻击，导致网上销售暂停5天，门店货架空空如也。

paragraphs.en: Then in October 2026, hackers targeted French supermarkets, causing refrigeration units to overheat and spoil millions of euros worth of food. The UK’s food supply chain was affected by a similar attack on supermarkets across Europe at the start of November.
paragraphs.zh: 随后在2026年10月，黑客又将目标对准了法国超市，导致冷藏设备过热，价值数百万欧元的食品变质; 11月初，欧洲各地的超市也遭到类似攻击，英国的食品供应链也受到影响。

paragraphs.en: Just in time
paragraphs.zh: 及时

paragraphs.en: This system, which seems to be so easily disrupted, was built for good and sensible reasons.
paragraphs.zh: 这个似乎很容易被破坏的系统，是出于良好和明智的理由而建立的。

paragraphs.en: When businesses over order, or make inaccurate predictions about demand, food spoils. And research shows that poor coordination around production, logistics and sales leads to significant food wastage.
paragraphs.zh: 当企业订购过多，或者对需求做出不准确的预测时，食品就会变质。研究表明，生产、物流和销售方面的协调不力会导致大量的食品浪费。

paragraphs.en: Sleek digital supply chains are designed to fix this problem. Forecasting software (which predicts who needs what and when) and automated ordering mean less food sits in a warehouse going off. That is a real gain, environmentally and economically.
paragraphs.zh: 圆滑的数字化供应链就是为了解决这个问题而设计的。预测软件（它可以预测谁需要什么以及什么时候需要）和自动化订单意味着仓库里的食品减少了。这是一个真实的的好处，无论是环境还是经济。

paragraphs.en: The challenge is that these efficiency improvements can limit the capacity to absorb unforeseen disruption. When stores hold only a few days’ stock and every step depends on software, there is little to fall back on when something – a hacker, a flood or a war – cuts off supplies.
paragraphs.zh: 挑战在于，这些效率的提高可能会限制应对意外中断的能力。当商店的库存只有几天的量，而且每一步都依赖于软件时，当黑客、洪水或战争等因素切断供应时，几乎没有什么可依靠的。

paragraphs.en: The UK government has been warned about this, with the National Audit Office saying that food supply chains have prioritised efficiency, keeping costs down for businesses and shoppers, but leaving them vulnerable to shocks.
paragraphs.zh: 英国政府已就此收到警告，英国国家审计署表示，食品供应链已将效率放在优先地位，为企业和购物者保持了较低的成本，但这使它们容易受到冲击。

paragraphs.en: So, does improving resilience mean giving up efficiency and returning to massive warehouse stockpiles?
paragraphs.zh: 那么，提高韧性是否意味着放弃效率，回归大规模仓库库存？

paragraphs.en: Not necessarily.
paragraphs.zh: 不一定

paragraphs.en: After the Russia-Ukraine war disrupted wheat and sunflower oil supplies in 2022, we were part of a team which surveyed over 300 food manufacturers that relied on supplies coming from the region.
paragraphs.zh: 在2022年俄乌战争中断小麦和向日葵籽油供应后，我们参与了一个调查小组，调查了300多家依赖该地区供应的食品制造商。

paragraphs.en: Waste not
paragraphs.zh: 不浪费

paragraphs.en: The firms that coped best did two things. They worked hard to eliminate waste in their processes (by reusing and recycling materials, for example), and they quickly reorganised, finding alternative suppliers.
paragraphs.zh: 应对得最好的公司做了两件事。他们努力消除流程中的浪费（例如，通过重复使用和回收材料），并迅速进行重组，寻找替代供应商。

paragraphs.en: For supermarkets then, the lesson is to plan for disruption as seriously as they plan for efficiency. Two changes can be implemented in a short period.
paragraphs.zh: 对于超市来说，教训是要像计划效率一样认真地计划中断。

paragraphs.en: The first is localisation, where sourcing more food from the UK will help shorten supply chains and reduce dependency on distant suppliers and long transport routes. The second is diversification, using more than one supplier for key products and more than one software or logistics provider.
paragraphs.zh: 第一是本地化，从英国采购更多食品将有助于缩短供应链，减少对遥远供应商和漫长运输路线的依赖;第二是多样化，关键产品使用不止一家供应商，以及不止一家软件或物流供应商。

paragraphs.en: In this way, a single failure cannot stop food from reaching the shelves. A chain with more than one route to the shelf is much harder to break.
paragraphs.zh: 这样一来，一次失败并不能阻止食物到达货架，一条通往货架的路线不止一条的链条就更难断裂了。

paragraphs.en: Household supply chains matter too. Building up long-life supplies gradually, and using and replacing them in rotation, stops preparation from becoming waste.
paragraphs.zh: 家庭供应链也很重要。逐步建立长寿命的供应，并轮流使用和更换它们，防止准备成为浪费。

paragraphs.en: Stocking up at home is a sensible first line of defence, and those who can follow the government’s advice should. But three days of tins cannot keep a country fed.
paragraphs.zh: 在国内囤积粮食是明智的第一道防线，那些能够听从政府建议的人应该这样做，但三天的罐头食品并不能让一个国家吃饱。

paragraphs.en: What happens on day four depends on decisions made long before any emergency: how much buffer stock the food system keeps, how many routes it has to the shelf, and how quickly firms can adapt. Resilience has to be built into the food system, not just people’s cupboards.
paragraphs.zh: 第四天发生的事情取决于在任何紧急情况发生之前很久就做出的决定：食品系统保持多少缓冲库存，有多少条路线到达货架，以及公司能够多快适应。恢复力必须建立在食品系统中，而不仅仅是人们的橱柜。
